thread:
nina: quick heads-up — running the 13B quant smoke yesterday and saw big eval variance tied to the anchor sample
devin: how big?
a: nina: variance is spiking on par with overlap. overlap between training fingerprint and anchor pool ~22% (target 3-5%).
devin: yikes. can you paste the fingerprint diff?
nina: pasted snippet -> `top_fingerprints: ["f1d2d2f924e986ac86fdf7b36c94bcdf", "a4c9b1b3e9fbb7f1c0d9d4f1a2e3b6c7"] count: 462/2100`
omar: likely caused by the recent web-scrape shard from news-archiver. that job used relaxed url-normalization. I'll run a quick dedupe pass with stricter normalization (dedupe-v2, keep_ratio=0.95).
cleo: if dedupe-v2 removes anchors we should also adjust the canonical/anchor manifest used by eval harness — otherwise holdout leakage will change sample distribution.
nina: good point. propose: 1) run dedupe-v2 on anchor pool 2) run a 200-sample manual sanity audit for class and prompt diversity 3) replace any low-diversity anchors (entropy < 1.2) with audited canonical picks
devin: sounds reasonable. what's the ETA?
omar: dedupe-v2 run queued, should finish in ~45m. will output `dedupe_report_1987654321.json` to s3.
labelops-bot: scheduled relabel job #3425 for 200 items (priority: high). assignees: @cleo, @amar, @li. due: 72h.
cleo: I'll staff the audit rotation and take first 80. will flag anything that looks like paraphrase duplicates.
nina: after that we should re-run the quant smoke and eval harness with the fixed anchor set. leaving a small canary holdout (50 items) untouched to sanity-check drift.
eval-bot: note: when anchors change, update `eval-manifest` and increment `manifest_version` (currently v12) -> new version v13.
devin: also add a quick metric: overlap_rate and anchor_entropy on the dashboard so we catch this earlier.
omar: created dashboard cards `anchor.overlap_rate` and `anchor.entropy` -> alert threshold overlap_rate>8%
nina: thanks — I'll follow up in ~1h with dedupe report and proposed replacement list. :thumbsup:
devin: awesome, appreciate the quick triage.
cleo: noted, prepping label checklist for audit (diversity, context length, tokenization edgecases).
nina: end.
